name: Kozuya Kanon
source: She is usually quiet and reserved, but once she opens up, she becomes an outspoken and unreserved person. Surprisingly, she has a hidden lecherous side and intense daydreaming tendencies. In reality, she also has a somewhat spoiled side. Having been pampered by her parents, she struggles with studying and tends to be messy in her room
